apps.name: ASMR App
apps.subtitle: Browse & download ASMR works
apps.localizedDescription:
A modern iOS app for browsing, downloading, and managing ASMR works from japaneseasmr.com.

Features:
• Browse latest ASMR releases
• Tag-based and keyword search
• CV autocomplete with 2100+ voice actors
• HLS stream downloads with M4A conversion
• On-device translation (10 languages)
• Organized library management
• Cloudflare bypass with cookie persistence
